Alt Text: Día de Muertos card: An ofrenda for the links that died. October's Live Reports followed the internal links of 263 public sites: on 178 every link answered, on 30 at least one led to a page that is gone, and on 18 of those the dead link was on the home page. The usual answer was 404 Not Found.
